verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own collaboration features that let business owners and accountants review and share financials. Firm plans include "roles and permissions", and the demo models an accounting-firm/client relationship. However, nothing shows a founder inviting an external accountant or assigning role-scoped access to adjust the books. missing for 10: a documented flow for a founder to invite an external accountant or bookkeeper, role scoping on the business (non-firm) side, explicit edit/adjust permissions for invited accountants, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: collaboration features that let business owners, finance teams, and accountants review and share financials without exporting into spreadsheets
Firm plans add "unlimited team seats, roles and permissions, central billing, task management, and flexible client-level plans."
illustrating both an accounting firm and a client
